name: Trail Shell Jacket
description: A three-layer waterproof shell with a helmet-compatible hood and pit zips. Cut for layering: size up if you plan to wear a heavy fleece underneath.

name: Merino Crew Sweater
description: Midweight 100% merino knit that regulates temperature and resists odor. Runs true to size with a relaxed body and slightly long sleeves.

name: Everyday Tee
description: Heavyweight organic cotton tee with a straight hem and a slightly dropped shoulder. Runs true to size; it softens and relaxes after a few washes.

name: Canvas Work Pant
description: 12-ounce duck canvas with a gusseted crotch and double-layer knees. Sized by waist in inches with a 32-inch inseam; the fit is straight through the leg.

name: Fleece Half-Zip
description: Recycled polyester grid fleece with a tall collar and a chest pocket. Runs small: size up if you are between sizes or want to layer underneath.

name: Down Puffer Vest
description: 650-fill recycled down in a packable vest with a stand collar and zip hand pockets. Runs true to size over a sweater; size down for a close fit over a tee.

name: Ridge Flannel Shirt
description: Brushed cotton flannel with a button-down collar and two chest pockets. Relaxed fit through the body; if you prefer it trim, size down.

name: Trail Hoodie
description: Midweight French terry hoodie with a lined hood and a kangaroo pocket. Runs true to size with a slightly longer body for coverage when bending.

name: Trail Shorts
description: Quick-dry stretch nylon shorts with a 7-inch inseam and a zip back pocket. Sized by waist in inches; the elastic waistband gives about an inch of room.

name: Rain Pants
description: Lightweight 2.5-layer waterproof pants with three-quarter side zips that pull on over boots. Cut roomy to go over other pants; order your usual size.

name: Merino Base Layer
description: Lightweight merino long-sleeve crew meant to sit next to skin. Runs snug by design; size up if you want it to fit like a regular shirt.

name: Canvas Field Cap
description: Unstructured six-panel cap in washed cotton canvas with a brass slide buckle. One size fits most, adjustable from 21 to 24 inches.

name: Wool Liner Gloves
description: Thin merino liner gloves with touchscreen fingertips. Sized S to L by palm width; they stretch, so when in doubt go down a size.

name: Linen Camp Shirt
description: Short-sleeve linen shirt with a camp collar and a boxy cut. Runs large: most people size down one for the intended drape.

name: Daypack 20L
description: A 20-liter daypack with a padded laptop sleeve, a stretch side pocket for a bottle, and a sternum strap. Weighs 720 grams.

name: Roll-Top Tote
description: Waxed canvas tote that rolls closed to keep rain out. Holds a 15-inch laptop flat, with a zip pocket inside for keys and a wallet.

name: Travel Duffel 45L
description: Carry-on sized duffel in recycled ballistic nylon with stowable backpack straps and a separate shoe compartment. 45 liters, 1.2 kilograms.

name: Sling Bag
description: A 4-liter crossbody sling with a quick-release buckle and a hidden back pocket. Fits a phone, wallet, keys, and a small water bottle.

name: Hip Pack 3L
description: A 3-liter lumbar pack with two bottle holsters and a stretch front pocket. The waist belt adjusts from 28 to 46 inches.

name: Weekender 35L
description: A 35-liter travel backpack that opens flat like a suitcase, with compression straps and a padded 16-inch laptop sleeve. Fits under most airline seats.

name: Packing Cubes, 3-Pack
description: Three ripstop cubes in small, medium, and large with mesh tops so you can see what is inside. Compress to about half their packed height.

name: Dry Bag 10L
description: A 10-liter roll-top dry bag in welded TPU. Keeps a change of clothes dry on a paddle or in a leaking pack. Not for submersion.

name: Canvas Messenger
description: Waxed canvas messenger with a leather flap strap and a padded 14-inch laptop pocket. The shoulder strap has a quick-adjust slider for riding.

name: Laptop Sleeve 14 inch
description: Felted wool sleeve with a leather pull tab, sized for 13 and 14-inch laptops. Slips inside the Daypack or the Weekender.

name: Market Tote
description: An open-top cotton canvas tote with long handles that sit on the shoulder and a flat bottom that stands up on its own. Machine washable.

name: Toiletry Kit
description: A hanging toiletry kit with a wipe-clean lining, a removable mirror, and three mesh pockets. Hook rotates to hang from any door or rail.

name: Insulated Bottle 750ml
description: Double-wall stainless steel bottle that keeps drinks cold for 24 hours or hot for 12. The wide mouth takes ice cubes and fits most car cup holders.

name: Wool Beanie
description: Chunky rib-knit beanie in a merino and nylon blend with a fold-over cuff. One size; the knit stretches to fit most heads comfortably.

name: Leather Belt
description: Full-grain bridle leather, 1.5 inches wide, with a solid brass buckle. Order two inches above your pant waist size.

name: Trail Socks, 3-Pack
description: Three pairs of merino-blend crew socks with a cushioned sole and arch support. Sized by US shoe size.

name: Polarized Sunglasses
description: Polarized lenses in a bio-based acetate frame with spring hinges. Medium fit, 50mm lens width, with a microfiber pouch.

name: Rechargeable Headlamp
description: A 400-lumen USB-C rechargeable headlamp with a red night mode and a tilting head. Runs 6 hours on high and 40 on low. Weighs 78 grams.

name: Trekking Poles
description: A pair of three-section aluminum poles with cork grips and flip locks. Adjust from 100 to 135 centimeters and collapse to 62 for travel.

name: Field Watch Strap
description: A 20mm two-piece nylon strap with a brushed steel buckle and keepers. Fits wrists from 6 to 8.5 inches.

name: Insulated Camp Mug
description: A 350ml double-wall stainless mug with a sliding lid. Keeps coffee hot for about three hours. Fits the bottle pocket on all our packs.

name: Carabiner Keychain
description: A machined aluminum carabiner with a split ring and a bottle opener. Not rated for climbing.

name: Wool Scarf
description: A lambswool scarf, 180 by 30 centimeters, with a brushed finish and fringed ends. Dry clean or hand wash cold.

name: Canvas Wallet
description: A bifold wallet in waxed canvas with a leather trim, six card slots, and a bill sleeve. Thinner than a leather bifold and softens with use.

name: Bandana, 2-Pack
description: Two 22-inch cotton bandanas in a printed topographic pattern. Doubles as a napkin, a sweatband, or a pot holder in a pinch.

name: Enamel Mug Set
description: Two 12-ounce steel mugs with a speckled enamel finish and a rolled rim. Fine on a camp stove; not for the microwave.

name: Camp Blanket
description: A recycled wool blend blanket, 60 by 80 inches, with a water-resistant nylon backing. Rolls into its own carry strap.

name: Cedar Candle
description: Soy wax candle with cedar and smoke notes in a reusable amber glass jar. Burns about 45 hours. Final sale.

name: Field Notebook, 3-Pack
description: Three pocket-sized notebooks with dot-grid pages and water-resistant covers. 48 pages each. Final sale.

name: Cast Iron Skillet, 10 inch
description: A pre-seasoned 10-inch skillet with a helper handle and two pour spouts. Works on induction, gas, oven, and open fire.

name: Linen Apron
description: Stonewashed linen apron with cross-back straps that take the weight off your neck, and two deep front pockets. One size.

name: Stovetop Kettle
description: A 1.5-liter enameled steel kettle with a wood handle and a whistling spout. Works on gas, electric, and induction.

name: Walnut Cutting Board
description: An end-grain walnut board, 12 by 18 inches, with a juice groove and a hanging hole. Oil it monthly; never put it in the dishwasher.

name: Wool Throw Pillow
description: A 20-inch pillow cover in a herringbone wool weave with a hidden zipper, insert included. Spot clean only.

name: Enamel Dutch Oven
description: A 5.5-quart cast iron dutch oven with a cream enamel interior and a tight-fitting lid. Oven safe to 500 degrees.

name: Camp Lantern
description: A rechargeable LED lantern with a warm dimmable glow and a fold-flat handle. Runs 60 hours on low and doubles as a phone charger.

name: Jute Doormat
description: A woven jute doormat, 18 by 30 inches, with a non-slip rubber backing. Shake out to clean; keep it under cover from heavy rain.

name: Tea Towel Set
description: Three linen-cotton tea towels, 20 by 28 inches, with a hanging loop. They get more absorbent with every wash.

name: Ceramic Planter
description: A 7-inch stoneware planter with a drainage hole and a matching saucer. Glazed outside, raw clay inside so roots can breathe.

name: Wool Area Rug
description: A flat-woven wool rug, 5 by 8 feet, in a two-tone stripe. Reversible; rotate it twice a year so it wears evenly.

name: Cork Coaster Set
description: Six 4-inch cork coasters, 8 millimeters thick, in a canvas sleeve. Wipe clean.

name: Beeswax Wraps
description: Three reusable food wraps in small, medium, and large, made of organic cotton coated in beeswax and jojoba oil. Last about a year with cold-water washing.
